family: Abstract analytical / conceptual editorial illustration — the accent lane of ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §4.3 (~10% of visual use).
primary_job: Frame an abstract thesis or give an article/project a durable conceptual metaphor when the visual metaphor itself adds explanatory or identity value (ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §2.5, §1 'frame').

semantic_density.rationale: The job is framing, not mechanism explanation: one dominant idea plus one or two supporting structures, not an argument map (SUENGJ-VISUAL-TASTE-CALIBRATION.md §4 density rule; ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §2.5).

visual_density.rationale: Generous negative space, restrained geometry, sparse connectors — the taste-calibration anchor for the publication's illustrative work (SUENGJ-VISUAL-TASTE-CALIBRATION.md §1-2).

text_policy.complexity_ceiling: No readable UI labels, numerical axes, citations, or logos; the schematic concept visual default is no in-artwork text (DIAGRAMMATIC-VISUAL-LANGUAGE.md §4, §7 schematic concept prompt template).

composition.dominant_structure: One central structure or bounded metaphor with a small number of satellite modules and sparse connectors (DIAGRAMMATIC-VISUAL-LANGUAGE.md §5.1).

audience_adaptation.child-upper-elementary: Use a literal, concrete depiction rather than a symbolic or schematic encoding; low abstraction (audience/child-upper-elementary.json modality_effects.visual: abstraction low).
audience_adaptation.domain-expert: The metaphor may compress domain-specific tension without an explanatory legend; abstraction ceiling is higher.
audience_adaptation.general-reader: Default anchor: restrained abstraction that still reads without domain background.

renderer_preference.rule: Conceptual illustration is the generative lane by design — it is not evidence-bearing. If a version needs exact geometry to land the metaphor, use deterministic only for that element; exact values or labels never belong here at all (ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §2.5, §4.3).

readability_gate.rationale: Used primarily as hero, section-opener, or identity placement rather than a body-facing explanatory plate; it inherits the general small-scale legibility expectation of ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §10 (hero: stronger silhouette, more crop tolerance) rather than the body-infographic mobile gate.

split_rule.rationale: A single bounded metaphor by construction; splitting would convert it into a body-infographic decision, which is out of scope for this artifact (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §6 applies to body infographics only).

acceptance: the reviewer can state which article claim or thesis the image supports (IMAGE-GENERATION.md §8)
one dominant structure, not an assembled icon library
does not imply fabricated evidence or invented data
reject: topic-cliché noun representation instead of the actual mechanism or distinction (ARTICLE-ILLUSTRATION-ROUTING.md §9)
decorative restatement of the thesis with no new framing (VISUAL-INFORMATION-GAIN.md §10 R4)
